info.name: tobistats
info.summary: Statistics, explorer tiles, map and training load from your Strava export
info.description: Shows your Strava export as statistics, explored tiles, a map of all tracks, an activity list, running statistics and your training load over the year. Everything is computed in your browser; nothing is sent to other servers unless you choose a background map. tobistats is not made by, affiliated with or endorsed by Strava. Strava is a trademark of Strava, Inc.
info.author: Tobias Mrowietz
